fieldValues.title: Page settings
fieldValues.summary: With no block selected: publish the page (or publish it as a draft, not indexed), end it with the closing mark, choose its layout, and edit its title and other page fields.
fieldValues.explanation: How a page sits in the site is set on the page itself: Published puts it on the site at its key's address at the next build; Published as draft serves it but asks search engines not to index it. The closing mark and layout are the site's own options.
fieldValues.ai_guidance: Remind the writer that publishing takes effect when the site is next built from the repository, after the change is saved.
